name: 𝟏𝐋𝐓 - 𝐀𝐛𝐝𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐚𝐡 𝐆 𝐄𝐋
bio: Frontend developer passionate about building feature-rich, Arabic-language web applications, specializing in turning ideas into complete, self-contained single-file HTML/CSS/JavaScript projects. My work blends technology with Islamic content and Egyptian culture — from prayer time and athkar apps to zakat calculators — alongside personal productivity tools and creative design software like a layer-based Arabic quote/poster design studio. I also build Electron-based desktop applications and Android-to-PC remote control systems using Python and ADB. With a disciplined background as a former first lieutenant in the Egyptian Army, I bring precision and creativity together in every project I take on
